reel_check.SOURCE: primary read in full: yes: blog.ja.playstation.com 9 Nov 2026 10:00 +09:00 (Portal announcement), catalog paragraph read in full
reel_check.SOURCE: not already posted: yes: ledger find 'Dragon Quest III' no match; 'PS Plus' hits are the 21 Oct leaving story and the 28 Oct November Essential post, neither is this
reel_check.ANGLE before lines: yes: story file angle (hook, why now, players here, payoff)
reel_check.STORY TYPE announcement: yes: strip carries the month and both games; line 1 the news; line 2 the publishers; line 3 the limit (rest of regions not announced)
reel_check.STORY: 17 November not used: yes: primary says 今月11月 and 12月 only; the Denfami date is not in the primary and is not on screen
reel_check.STORY: tiers and platforms: yes: Extra, Premium and PS4/PS5 left out (not in the primary)
reel_check.STORY: names match names-ar.md: yes: سكوير (Square Enix), كوي تكمو (Koei Tecmo) first mention with Latin, مدونة بلايستيشن; سوني
reel_check.STORY: release verbs: yes: no release verb; catalog addition wording only (إلى فهرس ألعاب)
reel_check.POST: Arabic passes: pending: arabic-games-film-editor, arabic-writing and arabic-grammar-review run before queuing (see story file)
reel_check.SOUND: footage sound: yes: the Gameplay trailer's own sound is narration throughout (transcript 0 to 150 s; Launch trailer narrated 8 to 75 s too), so it is not used under lines; the Announce trailer (Steam 2701660) is the only speech-free stretch (0 to 39 s empty): one stretch 8.0 to 24.0 s of its music under the whole Reel, music from another official trailer of the same game (21 Oct rule)
reel_check.SOUND: no speech under lines: yes: transcript shows no words in the Announce stretch 8 to 24 s
reel_check.PICTURE: footage first: yes: official Steam Gameplay trailer (ESRB EN Gameplay, 1080p 60 fps), gameplay picture, no title cards in the shots
reel_check.PICTURE: no slate on the first frame: yes: shot 1 starts at 8.0 s, after the title cards at 2 to 6 s; the winged art (8 to 11.5 s) is the first frame
reel_check.PICTURE: title cards avoided: yes: 0 to 8 s title text, 12 s black, 24 to 28 s 'The hour of awakening' cards, 30 to 34 s logo overlay, 36 s 'Development footage' text all out of the shot list
reel_check.PICTURE: credit on every clip: yes: credit 0 to 15.4 s covers every footage shot
reel_check.PICTURE: headline not over a face: yes: headline in the top band over shot 1 (winged art), no face
reel_check.PICTURE: not the same as last 5 Reels: yes: no earlier Reel on this trailer in the ledger; picture: Announce trailer, 8 to 30 s

decision_log: Picture: Gameplay trailer, six shots in source order: 8.0 forest with the party (2.5 s, cover, headline on it), 14.0 ruin hall (2.5 s), 20.0 snow field (2.9 s), 28.0 tavern interior (2.9 s), 32.0 village exterior (2.6 s), 54.0 red hall (3.0 s), 57.0 village fountain (2.6 s, picture close with no line: the last 2 s before the end card are a picture). Shots avoid 0 to 1 s (ESRB rating square), 25 to 27 s (STORY banner), 36 to 41 s (dialogue text box), 49 to 51 s (creature blood-like splash), 52 s (white transition). Sound: one stretch of the Announce trailer's music, 8.0 to 24.0 s, under the whole Reel (no speech in it; not the Gameplay trailer's narration). Lines L1 on shots 1 to 2 (about 5 s), L2 on 3 to 4 (about 5.8 s), L3 on 5 to 6 (about 5.2 s). Verified by transcript and frame sheet only, not by ear.
note: Japanese PlayStation Blog, Portal post of 9 Nov 2026 (the catalog paragraph): 今月11月 for Dragon Quest III (そして伝説へ... = the HD-2D Remake) and 12月 for Dynasty Warriors: Origins. Editor decision (a): built on the primary's wording, no day; the Denfami 17 November is not used; tiers and platforms out. Footage: Steam Gameplay trailer (ESRB EN Gameplay, app 2701660); its narration rules out its own sound under the lines. Sound: Announce trailer music, one stretch, speech-free.
